summary: Add a warning to the TypeScript SDK when it detects a workflow history exceeding a certain size threshold, helping users identify and optimize workflows with large histories.
userImpact: Users will receive warnings when their workflows accumulate large histories, helping them identify potential performance issues before they become critical.
proposedFix: Implement size monitoring in the SDK that detects when workflow history reaches or exceeds a configurable threshold and emits a warning to users.
keyQuote: Warn if SDK detects a workflow history over a certain size
